infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app requires access to the camera to allow seafarers to take photos of their certificates and documents for digital storage.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app does not use the microphone, but it is required by the underlying file picker libraries to ensure full compatibility.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SDM uses your location in the background to automatically record your vessel's midnight position for the Midnight Position Check log. This runs once daily at 00:00 London time.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: SDM uses your location in the background to automatically record your vessel's midnight position for the Midnight Position Check log.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: SDM uses your location to check if the vessel is inside or outside UK territorial waters (12nm) for the Midnight Position Check log.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: SDM uses your location in the background to automatically record your vessel's midnight position at 00:00 London time.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: SDM uses your location in the background to automatically record your vessel's midnight position at 00:00 London time.
